author: Carlos Martinez
title: Redondo Beach Car Show, April 2018: Hot Rods and Corvettes
description: Phone clips from a car show by the harbor in Redondo Beach, California, April 2018. A rat rod, a Viper, Corvettes, a Chevelle and a sunset.

sections.p: This is a set of clips from a car show by the harbor in Redondo Beach, California. I went in April 2018.
It was a real car show. It was not a race. I filmed the clips on my phone.

list: A rusty brown rat rod with a bare engine, chrome exhaust pipes out of the side, and whitewall tires on red wheels. A rat rod is a hot rod left rough on purpose.
A red Dodge Viper with the top down. The Viper was built with a V10 engine of 8 litres or more.
A silver classic Corvette with the hood up, in a row of cars with their hoods open. This third-generation Corvette was built from 1968 to 1982.
A red 1940s Ford, a green Porsche 911 and a red Chevelle SS with its hood up, all in one row.
A pale yellow Chevrolet Chevelle next to a gray modern Corvette with its hood up. Then a silver Spyder with 130 on its nose.
Sunset over the lot, with palm trees, a pale yellow old pickup and people walking between the cars.

sections.p: I filmed real racing that year too: the 2018 Long Beach Grand Prix.

faqs.a: At a car show by the harbor in Redondo Beach, California, USA. Redondo Beach is on the Pacific coast, southwest of downtown Los Angeles.

faqs.q: Is this iRacing or a real event?
faqs.a: It is a real car show. It is not a race and it is not iRacing. I filmed the clips on my phone.
